title: College Events and Festivals
content: Campus life at SRM is vibrant and filled with numerous extracurricular activities, technical symposiums, and cultural events. The two main annual national level festivals are: 1. Milan: A spectacular national-level cultural festival held in the even semester (usually March). It features celebrity performances, dance, music, drama, fashion shows, and art competitions, attracting students from colleges across India. 2. Aarush: A national-level techno-management fest held in the odd semester (usually September). It showcases technical innovations, coding challenges, robotics battles, hackathons, and guest lectures by renowned scientists and industry leaders. In addition, each department hosts its own annual national symposium (such as Texus, Computera, or CyberFest) providing students a platform to showcase their skills, publish research papers, and network with peers.
